comparisons_not_made: Care tiers are not compared with each other: families at different tiers use different carrier phrases and target words, so their endpoints are probabilities of different tokens in different contexts.
Strata are not pooled: a register contrast, a patient-explanation contrast and a syntax crossing are different manipulations.

design.status: draft, 2026-11-12: proposed by the batch-intake change; not agreed. The owner agrees it by a commit that changes this line.

eligibility_rules.confirmatory: a family's register contrast can enter a confirmatory statement only when the protocol is signed, the family has both reviews, it has no family flag, its split was assigned before measurement, and software validation passed
eligibility_rules.publication: docs/open_results_policy.md: an intact result of a hand-authored family is shared under public-display/1 whatever its effect, with its evidence class and review status shown. Publication does not need the reviews; it needs the labels.

endpoint.definition: the full-vocabulary probability of the first token of the family's declared target word at the position after the carrier phrase
is_not: evidence that a model understands a wording
endpoint.name: first_token_probability
endpoint.partial_when: the target word is more than one token; the endpoint then reads its first token only and is labelled partial

behavioural_pass_owner_kept.rates_label: measured (slowest successful run per model; sample size not recorded)
behavioural_pass_owner_kept.rates_source: scripts/backfill_planner.py SECONDS_PER_PAIR: the SLOWEST rate each model showed in its successful logits-eval runs on GitHub Actions up to 2026-10-09: the 'Measure next-token behavior' step's duration (model load included) over the pairs the run's trigger file asked for. Medians were about half these (gemma-3-4b-it 94, qwen3-1.7b 33, qwen3-4b 76, llama-3.2-3b 69, olmo-2-1b 37, gemma-2-2b-it 79 s/pair), so sizing on the slowest keeps a slow runner inside the timeout too

measurements.note: Directories under trace_out/ whose name starts with the stem. This command reads their names only and never their contents.

mechanistic_subset.ica_basis: one fitted basis per model, fitted on discovery families only, used unchanged for every register and every stratum
mechanistic_subset.rule: A method states which alignment classes it reads. A family is never rewritten to reach a class: unnatural patient wording is a worse defect than a coarser alignment.
mechanistic_subset.selection: a seeded draw of families, made before any measurement of the batch, from owner-kept discovery families in the register stratum without flags; care levels are visited in turn. Held-out families are not drawn: a mechanism developed on them could not be confirmed on them.

review_layers.clinician_review: six dimensions of the rubric, recorded by a clinician
review_layers.owner_read: the owner's keep or exclude decision on a named version of the texts. It is not a clinician's review.
review_layers.patient_language_review: two items of the rubric, recorded by a patient-language reviewer
review_layers.software_validation: structural checks by this command. It says nothing about clinical content or patient language.

software_validation.is: structural checks by this command. It says nothing about clinical content or patient language.

splits.method: python random.Random(seed); for each care level from highest to lowest: sort the family ids, rng.shuffle, first half discovery, next quarter validation, rest fresh_test
splits.open: families per split is not fixed in the protocol (its section 14)
splits.unit: case family: every wording of a case is in the family's split

tokenization.note: No tokenizer file is available offline. Token ids come from a recorded run; until then alignment is known at word level only.
